findings.issue: aria-label on the broken-edges <ul> still uses the generic funnels.canvas.brokenEdge key whose resolved value is 'Broken connection — target deleted'. When the list contains only an on_start_entry_null item, the list-level label is semantically incorrect (nothing was deleted).
findings.impact: Screen-reader users hear a misleading container label; does not block sighted users or any functional path.
findings.recommendation: Either use a locale-neutral label such as 'funnels.canvas.brokenEdgesLabel' (e.g. 'Connection issues') that does not mention deletion, or suppress the static aria-label and rely on the per-item text which is already accurate.

findings.issue: The ?? fallback in brokenEdgeMessageKey to 'funnels.canvas.brokenEdge' is unreachable: BROKEN_EDGE_MESSAGE_KEYS is typed as Record<BrokenEdge['reason'], string>, which is an exhaustive mapping over the two-member union. TypeScript will enforce completeness at compile time, so the guard can never fire.
findings.impact: Dead code — no runtime risk, but it implies the generic key remains in use as a runtime safety net when it is not. If BrokenEdge['reason'] grows a third member the Record type will catch it at compile time, making the runtime fallback redundant.
findings.recommendation: Keep the fallback as a defensive measure and document why ("future-proofing for union growth before types regenerate"), or remove it and rely solely on the exhaustive Record type. Current state is acceptable; a brief comment would clarify intent.

checks.fallback_for_unknown_reasons: pass — ?? 'funnels.canvas.brokenEdge' guards unknown future reasons at runtime.

checks.i18n_keys_present_uk: pass — brokenEdgeMissingTarget and brokenEdgeStartNotConnected present and non-empty in uk.json.
checks.i18n_parity: pass — check-locales.mjs exited 0; both locales have identical key sets.
checks.required_keys_spec_updated: pass — both new keys added to REQUIRED_KEYS in required-keys.spec.ts.

checks.activation_guard_intact: pass — existing 'renders the start node broken when on_start entryStepId is null' test and the new message-assertion tests exercise the on_start_entry_null path.

checks.aria_label_sensible: minor concern — aria-label on <ul> uses generic 'target deleted' wording regardless of reason; see finding above.

summary: Presentation-only change is correct. Both broken-edge reasons map to accurate, distinct i18n keys. Detection logic is untouched. i18n parity passes check-locales. required-keys.spec.ts is updated. Three new tests cover the two reason-specific messages and the banner-clear regression. Two minor findings: the <ul> aria-label remains worded as 'target deleted' even when only an on_start_entry_null item is present (misleading for assistive tech), and the runtime fallback in brokenEdgeMessageKey is unreachable given the exhaustive Record type. Neither is a blocker.
